title: Ferry announcement
instructions: Limanda kısa bir feribot anonsu. Kısa ama değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Passengers for the ten thirty ferry to the island, please listen.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Because of strong winds, the ferry will leave at twelve fifteen.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Car passengers should go to lane three. Foot passengers should wait in the café.

questions.evidence: the ten thirty ferry to the island

options: There is a problem with the engine.

questions.prompt: What time will the ferry leave now?
questions.feedback: Feribot on ikiyi çeyrek geçe kalkacak.
questions.evidence: the ferry will leave at twelve fifteen.

questions.feedback: 10:30'dan 12:15'e: bir saat kırk beş dakika (bir saat ve dörtte üç).
questions.evidence: the ferry will leave at twelve fifteen.
